table.name: customers
table.purpose: Customer master table: one row per customer, with a segment code and preferred billing currency. Referenced by transactions_1k (customer id) and yearmonth (likely a customer-period table keyed by customer).

col_001.name: customer_id
col_001.description: Primary key; unique customer identifier (integer). Referenced by transactions_1k.col_004 (the customer on each transaction) and by yearmonth.col_001 (per-customer monthly records).

col_002.name: customer_segment
col_002.description: Customer segment code with three levels: SME (26763), LAM (3658), KAM (2040). Likely 'Small/Medium', 'Large Account Manager' and 'Key Account Manager' segments, i.e. small, large and key accounts. Exact expansion of the acronyms is not certain; no joined columns provide further evidence.

col_003.name: currency
col_003.description: Customer's billing currency: CZK (Czech koruna, 30459) or EUR (2002).

table.name: gasstations
table.purpose: Directory of gas stations: one row per gas station, with its chain/segment, country, and price segment classification. Referenced by transactions (transactions_1k.col_006).

col_001.name: station_id
col_001.description: Primary key: unique numeric identifier of the gas station. Referenced by transactions_1k.col_006 (each transaction belongs to one station).

col_002.name: chain_id
col_002.description: Foreign key to products.col_001 (product_id), so it identifies a row of the product catalog; plausibly the chain/operator the station belongs to (233 distinct values, most common shared by 1462 stations), but the join to a product key makes this reading uncertain.

col_003.name: country_code
col_003.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the station: CZE (Czech Republic) or SVK (Slovakia).

col_004.name: segment
col_004.description: Price/market segment classification of the station: Premium, Value for money, Discount, Noname, or Other.

table.name: products
table.purpose: Product/service catalog of items sold at gas stations (fuel, tolls, fees, groceries, services), referenced by transactions and gas stations.

col_001.name: product_id
col_001.description: Primary key: unique numeric product identifier (1-630, 591 distinct values). Referenced by transactions_1k.col_008 (line items) and gasstations.col_002.

col_002.name: product_name
col_002.description: Name/description of the product or service, in Czech and English: fuels, tolls (Toll access-Austria, Toll DEU), fees (Servisní poplatek, Acquirer Simple Fee), groceries (Potraviny), card issuance (Vydání karty), etc. Not unique (529 distinct in 591 rows), so some products share names.

table.name: transactions_1k
table.purpose: Fuel/gas station point-of-sale transactions: one row per purchase by a customer at a gas station, with date, time, product purchased, quantity and total price. Joins to customers, gasstations and products lookup tables.

col_002.name: transaction_date
col_002.description: Date of the transaction (stored as string). All rows fall within 2012-08-23 to 2012-08-26.

col_003.name: transaction_time
col_003.description: Time of day of the transaction, HH:MM:SS, stored as text.

col_004.name: customer_id
col_004.description: Reference to customers.col_001; identifies the customer making the purchase.

col_006.name: gasstation_id
col_006.description: Reference to gasstations.col_001; identifies the gas station where the purchase occurred.

col_007.name: amount
col_007.description: Quantity purchased, most likely in liters of fuel (dominant values 2 and 5, range 2-352). The mode at 2 and 5 suggests common fill-up volumes; unit is inferred, not confirmed. Alternative reading: it could be a monetary amount per line, though total_price (col_009) already covers the transaction total, making quantity the more plausible interpretation.

col_008.name: product_id
col_008.description: Reference to products.col_001; identifies the product (fuel type or shop item) purchased.

col_009.name: total_price
col_009.description: Total price of the transaction in currency units (range 1.76 to 5762.49, mean 425.58). Consistent with amount x unit price.

table.name: customer_monthly_spend
table.purpose: Aggregated spending per customer per month (YYYYMM), likely derived from the transactions tables; col_003 is the total amount spent by that customer in that month, with negative values indicating refunds/credits.

col_001.name: customer_id
col_001.description: Identifier of the customer; references customers.col_001 (many-to-one). Each customer appears in many rows (one per month).

col_002.name: year_month
col_002.description: Month identifier in YYYYMM format (values 201112 through 201311, i.e. Dec 2011 to Nov 2013). Stored as VARCHAR but numeric.

col_003.name: total_spend
col_003.description: Total amount spent by the customer in that month (currency, likely euros given the gas-station context). Mostly positive; negative values (min -582092.86) suggest refunds, reversals or credit adjustments. Tentative: could be a balance/loyalty-points amount instead of spend, but the distribution and transaction context support a monthly spend total.
